system.description:
Cursed item (seems a Scarab of Protection). Carried for a day, it burrows towards your heart: Fortitude save (DC 17) or drop to 0 HP and start dying; on a success, 6d10 piercing damage. It then crumbles.

Monsters & Treasure, Cursed Items.

  • Identify shows only what it seems; once the curse shows, it can't be put down or taken off until Remove Curse frees the user, and the item stays cursed.
  • Valued as the item it imitates.
  • Save DC 15 unless the entry says otherwise.
system.unidentifiedDescription:
Advantage on saves against spells. 12 charges: spend one to pass a failed save against necrotic magic or an undead. At 0 it crumbles.

Rarity: Very Rare
